verdict.rationale: Honeybadger has building blocks for trend analysis. Deployment tracking correlates code changes with errors (docs-29), search can filter errors that occurred since the last deploy (docs-20), and BadgerQL/Insights supports aggregations and calculations (docs-35). Anomaly detection tracks project error volume against a learned baseline (docs-9). However, the evidence never describes actual dashboards, cross-project or team-level views, or top-regression reporting, so a leader would have to assemble these views from queries. Missing for 10: documented error-trend dashboards, cross-project/team rollups, top-regression views, a built-in new-issues-per-release report, and any independent corroboration.
